name: EntityChip
description:
A Glass UX entity mentioned by the assistant, the user or the composer: glyph (with the
endpoint's live status dot), name, and one data meta (ticket state, version). It is a
link: click navigates, hover or focus opens a preview card, right-click (Shift+F10)
opens the entity's actions — the same definition as its own page (R12).
signature: ({ entity, size, variant, preview, glyph, onRemove, className, ...rest }: EntityChipProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: entity
props.description: Entity reference supplied by the host.

props.name: glyph
props.description: Draw the entity glyph (off when a tile beside it already shows it).

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Render a removable, non-navigating chip (composer context, picked entities).

props.name: preview
props.description: Show the preview card on hover and focus (default for links).

props.name: size
props.description: inline: inside prose (20px, sits in the line box) · sm: rows, composer, cards (24px).

props.name: variant
props.description: chip: a soft pill (prose, composer) · plain: glyph and name only (table cells, lists).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
